selection_policy.modern_style: Reviewed public representative artworks; primarily modern Japanese-style characters, with selected digital painting and atmosphere artists.
selection_policy.sfw_scope: Public profile/top samples; observed restricted or AI-generated samples and explicit adult profile markers are excluded. Not a lifetime account certification.
selection_policy.popularity_metric: Follower counts are not used. Known artists and multiple public official features seed a broad pool; review modern style and current activity.
selection_policy.danbooru_verification: Pinned 2026-10-06 Danbooru-derived artist tag metadata; live API unavailable. Snapshot count, not live reading.
